summary: The proposed body has the stated finite radial lattice-fiber profile, and the shell counts and exact integer certificates correctly establish every strict singleton, primitive-line-coset, anchor, and off-diagonal hypothesis. For every nonzero symmetric pair, the exact bound q>20/21 makes both root volumes jointly feasible in the defining maximum, so every Psi summand is zero. The remaining anchor term is exactly gamma_10 w_0, and the final exact certificate proves it is strictly less than W/64. The optional mixed-depth calibration is also correct.
